q_A: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code = T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code
gold_q_B: SELECT "t2"."property_type_description" AS "property_type_description" FROM "Properties" AS "t1" JOIN "Ref_Property_Types" AS "t2" ON "t1"."possessions_class_num" = "t2"."property_type_code" GROUP BY "t1"."possessions_class_num"

q_A: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code = "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code = "Apartment" AND room_count > 1
gold_q_B: SELECT "properties"."estate_name" AS "property_name" FROM "Properties" AS "properties" WHERE "properties"."possessions_class_num" = 'House' UNION SELECT "properties"."estate_name" AS "property_name" FROM "Properties" AS "properties" WHERE "properties"."possessions_class_num" = 'Apartment' AND "properties"."number_room" > 1
